<!-- If you're not sure whether your problem is a bug, please ask a question at
https://robotics.stackexchange.com instead.-->

## Environment
* OS Version: Ubuntu 24.04, Ubuntu 26.04
* Source or binary build? Binary: 1.0.25 (jazzy) and 3.0.12 (lyrical)
  <!-- If binary, which version? -->
  <!-- If source, which branch and what is the latest commit? -->

## Description
* Expected behavior: The track field should contain the direction of travel represented in degrees, with North as the reference and the angle increasing with clockwise rotation
* Actual behavior: The track field is in radians, with East as the reference and the angle increasing with counter-clockwise rotation.

## Steps to reproduce
<!-- Provide steps so we can try to reproduce this issue -->

1. Load a Gazebo world with the `gz-sim-navsat-system` plugin loaded
2. Load a model into the world with a `navsat` sensor attached to any link
3. Run ros_gz_bridge configured to convert the `gz.msgs.NavSat` Gazebo message to a `gps_msgs/GPSFix` ROS message, with direction `GZ_TO_ROS`
4. Echo the ROS GPSFix topic and observe the track field
new_candidates.title: ros_gz_bridge: gps_msgs/GPSFix converter incorrectly populates the track field
